notice-examine.title: cutbank crossing route notice
lines: The dressing shelter is west; the abandoned works
are east. A scarlet-banded frog rests beside the
direct mire crossing; striking its caustic skin can
poison you. Raised boards turn north around the
cut; the southern bank also stays dry. Both detours
are longer. Heating mire can release poisonous
marsh gas. Leather boots are armor, not protection
from the mire.
Type: Object

post.raw: A short dry crossing is watched from this post. Four drams buy one local passage. The longer dry boardwalks and the wet crossing remain open.
